name: qovia
description: Hosted MCP server for public data from 20+ platforms, including Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Weibo, Bilibili, TikTok, YouTube, X and Reddit, as structured JSON. Search the endpoint catalog without a key; add your Qovia API key to run calls.

QOVIA_API_KEY.title: Qovia API key
QOVIA_API_KEY.description: Create a key at https://qovia.ai/console/?tab=keys (it starts with sk-qovia-).
